architectureConsultation.recommendation: Deliver validated constructor cache, then stop this optimization cycle; do not rush worker offload.
architectureConsultation.remainingConstraint: Requested 10x virtual playback can saturate CPU when work exceeds available capacity; cooperative yielding improves interaction but does not remove computation.
architectureConsultation.futureWorkerProposal: One worker owns resident Run; epoch/sequence commands and ordered acknowledgements; append-only display deltas with bounded publication and stable main-thread history mirror.
architectureConsultation.workerDecisionTrigger: Representative input-to-paint latency including pre-dispatch delay remains unacceptable because of computation; validate clone cost and command/replay equivalence first.

data.note: CDP input is browser-trusted but synthetic; EventTiming duration is next-paint timing with the browser 8ms quantization, not physical-device latency.

limitations: One run per advicee count and variant, ten trusted gesture events per case; not a stable latency distribution.
Only one current gesture per case began while Play was active; subsequent timeline interactions were observed while paused. Loaded-playing evidence is limited.
CDP inputs are browser-trusted synthetic events; physical-device and network latency are excluded.
EventTiming input-to-next-paint durations are quantized, and entries below the configured 16ms threshold are censored. rAF followups are supplementary.
trustedInputToPaintDiagnostic.interpretation: Observed current event-to-next-paint maxima were 40ms for one and six advicees; baseline maxima were 32ms and 56ms. No page errors. These small samples do not establish a universal input-latency guarantee or an additional architecture blocker.

budget.decision: Finish the bounded measured optimization cycle before the maximum budget after validated delivery and responsiveness diagnostics; defer worker architecture.
